{{Top|leg}}
A '''specialized subprocessor''' was a dedicated processing unit designed to assist a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with performing a specific task more efficiently. They varied in size and cost, but generally they allowed the droid to do a task more efficiently or simultaneously with other tasks.
